_comment: FormationTriggerRule (IP-T443, IP-LAW-7): the thresholds a live GapperFormationSnapshot must clear for the formation recorder to count the symbol as a gapper worth arming. EVERY threshold is null until the gapper study (docs/research/gapper-study-2026-11) sets them from its validation results; an all-null rule never passes, so nothing is ever armed from formation data before the study says what works. Even a passing rule only arms when SettingsKv formation.arming.enabled is true and the owner's route is paper; this build records TriggerPassed and writes a formation-blocked audit row instead of arming.
